comment: An agent-written HUD with fixed corners on a transparent page: translucent corner panels with backdrop-filter, gradient bars clipped by a rounded overflow: hidden track (border-radius: inherit), a circular minimap with an ::after marker, a flex row of ability slots (one at reduced opacity), a centered crosshair; the HP bar's width transitions after a style change (captured half way and at the end). Text-heavy (boxes are the oracle): the glyph rasterization differs from Chromium's (FreeType hinting, synthetic bold outline vs bitmap dilation); with the text made transparent the page matches at the strict metric (checked when it was added).
